vector_memory.semantic_summary: The NumberRange class encapsulates a numeric value constrained by defined minimum and maximum bounds. It enforces boundary integrity by automatically clamping any assigned value between its min and max limits. It inherits from JsonSerializable, enabling reliable serialization and deserialization to/from JSON structures. The setters for min and max implement interdependent checks to maintain consistent range definitions.
